arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Jeffrey Fisher argued that no one has been executed for rape in forty-three years.
He claimed a long-standing national consensus exists against this punishment.
He stated that Louisiana's attempt violates the Eighth Amendment.
Ms. Clark described the brutal nature of the specific crime involved.

paragraphs: This case defines the limits of capital punishment for non-homicide crimes. It determines whether states can execute offenders for severe sexual violence. The outcome shapes future sentencing laws for violent crimes.
